verdict.rationale: A visual no-code workflow builder is a fair question for a workflow and automation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Trigger.dev is code-first: tasks are plain TypeScript async/await functions with no workflow DSL. Community users describe it as 'IFTTT/Zapier/N8N but in code' and as a deliberate move away from GUI workflows. Nothing in the pack shows a visual editor for building multi-step workflows.
